newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay shrs clip gains by mid-day on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Bombay shrs clip gains by mid-day on profit-taking.

text.p: ** (0715 GMT) - Bombay stocks falter in early afternoon
trade as profit-takers arrest early rise
** Bombay index up 8.35 pts, or 0.20 pct, at 4,259.48, off
** Activity seen shifting to smaller capitalised stocks in
broader market on gradual investment interest -- dealers
** National exchange index up 4.80 pts at 1,205.50
** Federal police to continue arguments on Thursday for
arrest of Bihar chief minister Laloo Prasad Yadav in a
$280-million corruption case; market to keep watch
